"High frequency hit rate：20-50% Think about the main ideas and details of the pictures as you prepare. Pay attention to the organizational structure of the language. You can create your own template and be familiar with it to ensure fluency."

"All the requirements and pronunciation habits should be kept while doing DI practicing. For instance, the voice volume cannot be lower than the students’ next to you and it needs to be higher and deeper. Oral fluency: you need to be more skillful and be able to answer it completely naturally and smooth. In this examination, fluency is required far beyond your normal level. Content: the content of DI could be illogical. Scores are given according to the key words. The keywords that need to be mentioned are showed below: 1.There are at least two numbers in the horizontal axis 2.There are at least two numbers with units in the horizontal axis 3.While describing a picture, all of the written information needs to be mentioned besides saying the source（the name of publishing company）of the picture. 4. The fluency of the template must be ensured and you need to keep practicing until you are able to read templates both in a fast and a slow speed, because sometimes you need time to think what comes after that. Reading the template a little bit slower could give you more time. 5.What’s showed in the picture is the most important and it has a great influence on the content score. So please make sure your pronunciation is clear. While describing, you could add some common words and words related to the content of the picture, such as, decrease, increase, the first, the second, the largest，slowly, dramatically etc. By doing this, your content score could be improved."

"Basic voice condition: breathing is very unstable , Frequent pause Oral fluency: too slow, the pronunciation is drawled. Also, there are too many pauses and some of them are random pauses Sense group: split sense groups randomly; the tone is not falling at the end of sense group. The stop before “that” is reasonable. But the pause in middle of the sense group “the hunted specimen’s brains” is incorrect, which has a negative influence on the score of oral fluency. Besides, the tone of “Controlled specific” should go down. Stressing and reducing: “the “ in the phrase of ”the hunted” is stressed, which is incorrect. Obvious errors in words: Completely mispronounces the word ”analysis”; “liver” should be pronounced as /'lɪvə/ not /'laivə/; Mouth and tongue position: Mouth and tongue position: The pronounce of the word “brain “sounds like breen; the diphthong “au” became “ou” in the word “found”; Hunted becomes haunted; diphthong “ai” is not perfect in the word “surprising. the last syllable should pronounce “zing”in this word; diphthong “ai” should more full in the word “kind”;consonant “v”is not clear in the word “Average”, but this student pronounce with no bite with underlip."

"Firstly, in terms of oral fluency, it needs to be relatively fluent. But there are several problems with sentence segmentation. For example, in the first sentence, there is a long pause from the template “this lecture talks about”to the content“a female writer”. Please try not to pause in the middle of a short sentence. By doing this, the sense group is relatively clear. Besides, from the template to the content, there are obvious stops, which means more practice is required. Using the template is mainly to improve oral fluency. So you cannot stop practicing until you can use the templates flexibly and say the key words or key sentences without hesitation. Secondly, in terms of content, there is a lot of detailed information, such as “30 years old”, “ten too twelve years”,“do the same way”, “take deep breaths”. However, the key information is not mentioned. For instance, “she always had a dream to write fiction, a great novelist influenced her by inspiring her to take some risks”. Thirdly, in terms of pronunciation, key words are pronounced clearly because all the words written down are phrases or words. But the pronunciation of the template is vague, and the vowels are not full enough. Please say the words as accurate as possible and do not give up on the pronunciation score to improve your fluency ."
